hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { msg=""; m=/Users/severin/Documents/sevdev/wolfpack; if [ "$(git -C "$m" symbolic-ref -q --short HEAD)" = master ] && ! git -C "$m" merge -q --ff-only origin/master >/dev/null 2>&1; then msg="The main checkout (what the game loads) could not catch up with origin/master: uncommitted changes in the same files, or commits of its own. Pull there. "; fi; [ -x "$m/link-addons.sh" ] && "$m/link-addons.sh" >/dev/null; if ! out=$(luajit test/smoke.lua 2>&1 && luajit test/barstack.lua 2>&1); then msg="${msg}Wolfpack test FAILED and the addon is live via symlink: $(printf '%s' "$out" | head -1)"; fi; [ -n "$msg" ] && jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{systemMessage: $m}'; true; }
hooks.statusMessage: Updating the game's copy, testing Wolfpack
